title: Crude Disruption Sends Fuel Prices Higher
summary: An outage at two Gulf loading terminals has pulled roughly two million barrels a day out of the market with no announced restart date.
briefing_text: Two Gulf loading terminals went offline within thirty hours of each other, removing close to two million barrels a day from seaborne supply. Benchmark crude is up nineteen percent on the week and retail fuel prices have begun to follow. Producer governments describe the outages as technical; our reporting is fragmentary and does not yet support a stronger characterization. Households will feel this within two weeks, which is faster than any policy we can pass.

cabinet_assessment.state: The Gulf governments will take a call today if we make one, Mr. President. They would rather be asked than pressured, and the difference is worth about a week of supply.
cabinet_assessment.defense: Fuel is a war-fighting commodity, sir. A sustained shock at this level changes what I can afford to keep at sea by the third quarter.
cabinet_assessment.treasury: This is a tax on households that nobody voted for. Every relief instrument we have is either slow, inflationary, or both, and I would rather choose deliberately than reactively.
cabinet_assessment.nsa: Expect opportunism while prices stay high. Adversaries with hydrocarbons to sell get bolder when the market is doing their work for them.
cabinet_assessment.chief_of_staff: Pump prices move your approval faster than anything else in American politics, sir. Two weeks, not two quarters.
cabinet_assessment.intelligence: Our reporting on the cause is fragmentary and I would resist anyone in this building characterizing it as deliberate. Confidence is low and I do not expect it to improve quickly.

choices.label: Release Strategic Reserves
choices.description: Authorize a substantial drawdown from the strategic petroleum reserve to bridge the outage.

advisor_positions.treasury: It works on the price for roughly a quarter, Mr. President, and refilling it later will cost us more than the barrels are worth today.
advisor_positions.defense: The reserve is a war stock before it is a price instrument, sir. I would want a refill schedule signed the same day as the drawdown.

memory.action: ordered a strategic reserve drawdown during the price spike

choices.outcome_text: The drawdown was announced before markets opened and took roughly nine cents off the national average within three weeks. The Department of Energy has not yet published a refill schedule.

advisor_positions.chief_of_staff: Diplomacy is slow and the pump is fast. If this takes more than three weeks we own the price and the trip.

advisor_positions.chief_of_staff: People will feel this within a month, which is the only thing about it I like, and it is enough for me to recommend it.
